Message:
That day,
some of the holy sword
Caladbolg’s light returned.

It may be just a glimmer,
but having lost
everything I held dear,

the sight was like
a shining beacon
piercing through the darkness.

But, this is still nothing
compared to how
Caladbolg shone before...
Just how can I bring it
back to what it once was...?

The downward swing of my sword
was full of hesitation.
It’s no use.
I can’t concentrate at all.

I let out a small sigh,
then sheathed my sword.

The Duke’s mansion is
so peaceful again today,
it’s almost dull.
My days here remind me of

those I spent training
with everyone before our journey.

As I thought back
to those days,
my friend’s faces
floated into my mind.

Haah...
I can’t focus on training anyway,
so I might as well take a break.

And besides,
I sort of feel like
seeing everyone now...
